seo.title: Jérôme: The Exalted Name of the Lord (Latin, Christianity)
seo.meta_description: Discover the meaning and religious significance of the name Jérôme. A Latin name with deep Christian roots, Jerome is the name of a revered saint and scholar known for his translation of the Bible into Latin.
seo.description_paragraph: The name Jérôme is derived from the Latin word 'Jeromeos', which means 'exalted name of the Lord'. In Christianity, Jerome is the name of a renowned saint, scholar, and doctor of the Church who played a significant role in the preservation and transmission of the Bible. Born in the late 3rd or early 4th century, Jerome is remembered for his devotion to the study of scripture and his tireless efforts to create a Latin version of the Bible that would serve as the basis for future translations. His work, known as the Vulgate, is still used by the Catholic Church today.
